standards.Districts: Primary signs in C-2, C-3, C-4, Q, M-1, M-2 and M-3 with major or super arterial frontage (See A.1-7 after Table for additional information).
standards.Maximum Number:
One per street frontage for premises less than six acres, but not to exceed three signs per premise; 
Two per street frontage for premises of six acres or more, but not to exceed four signs per premise.
